subject: Data Structures through C
text: Which principle does a stack follow?
explanation: A stack removes the most recently pushed item first.

subject: Data Structures through C
text: Which principle does a queue follow?
explanation: A queue removes the earliest enqueued item first.

subject: Data Structures through C
text: What is the worst-case time complexity of linear search in n items?
explanation: Linear search may inspect all n items.

subject: Data Structures through C
text: What does a singly linked-list node normally store besides data?
optionA: A pointer to the next node
explanation: Each singly linked node links to its successor.

subject: Data Structures through C
text: What is the worst-case time complexity of merge sort?
explanation: Merge sort divides and merges in O(n log n) time.

subject: Data Structures through C
text: What must a recursive function have to stop recursive calls?
explanation: A base case terminates recursion.
